title: add-benchmark-lab-performance-suites-profiling-baselines-and-reporting-pipeline-v130
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Adds v130 performance test suites, new profiling baselines, representative workload runners for Llama and TGI families, and a reporting pipeline to materialize results in BigQuery and Looker.
description: Motivation: expand Benchmark Lab coverage for mixed-sequence and multi-variant workloads and provide stable profiling baselines for kernel-selection and KV-cache cold-starts. This PR introduces versioned performance test suites (v130), representative workload runners for Llama-2 and TGI-based models (chat, summarization, streaming embeddings), profiling baselines (kernel-selection traces, memory/cold-start profiles), and an end-to-end reporting pipeline that aggregates raw run artifacts into BigQuery tables and triggers Looker dashboard refreshes. Changes are gated behind a feature flag BENCH_LAB_V130 and are backwards compatible with existing runners. High-level changes: new benchmark definitions under benchmark-lab/suites/v130, runner harnesses under benchmark-lab/runners/{llama,tgi}, k8s job templates and autoscaling hints under infra/k8s/benchmark-jobs, profiling instrumentation and tracing helpers under benchmark-lab/profiling, an Airflow DAG plus GCS->BigQuery loader under reporting/airflow, and CI updates to run a lightweight benchmark-smoke job on PRs plus a nightly profiling workflow. Testing: local and cluster runs against a100-80g and rtx-a-102 pools, regression evals against a small prompt set, deterministic seeds added to reduce flakiness, and end-to-end reporting validated by materializing a staging dataset and verifying Looker tiles. Rollout plan: merged to main, nightly runs enabled behind feature flag for first two weeks, monitor telemetry for regressions and rollback flag if unit-TP90 or token-cost regressions exceed thresholds. Related work: ENG-9803 (benchmark lab orchestration), ENG-9810 (profiling baselines), references to earlier pipeline efforts pr-741256 and pr-765432.

review_comments: Marco Rivera (2025-11-13): Overall a strong set of changes. Two requests: (1) please add a small unit test for the kernel-trace helper to prevent regressions; (2) ensure the GCS->BQ loader uses the retry/backoff helper (we've seen transient GCS errors).
Aisha Patel (2025-11-13): Added kernel-trace unit test and wired retry helper in loader; updated CI to run the new unit test in PR jobs.
Liang Chen (2025-11-14): The benchmark-smoke job was flaky on arm runners in my first run. Can we gate ARM jobs or reduce concurrency?
Aisha Patel (2025-11-14): Reduced concurrency for ARM in the smoke job and added an explicit skip for ARM in smoke on PRs; nightly still runs full matrix.
Priya Nair (2025-11-14): Please call out costs and quota impact in release notes and make sure the feature flag is off by default in production clusters.
Aisha Patel (2025-11-14): Added cost/quotas section to release notes and ensured BENCH_LAB_V130 defaults to off in production config.
Marco Rivera (2025-11-15): CI green, approving for merge.

notes_on_rollback: Feature flag BENCH_LAB_V130 can be toggled to disable nightly jobs and new runners
reporting/airflow/dags/benchmark_reporting_v130.py can be disabled in Airflow by pausing DAG benchmark_reporting_v130
GCS->BigQuery loader is idempotent; re-runable ingestion available via reporting/gcs_to_bq/loader.py --date
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: increased nightly cost due to additional profiling runs. Mitigation: feature flag off by default, schedule reduced frequency for first two weeks and monitor token-cost metrics.
Risk: flaky smoke tests on ARM. Mitigation: reduced concurrency and skip on PRs; full nightly matrix remains in controlled env.
Risk: transient GCS errors during ingestion. Mitigation: loader uses internal retry/backoff helper and logs failed batches for retry.
